T-001.Title: Make docs/plans WriteEvidence paths ordinary declared scope in the ledger audit

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Red-first, before the runtime change: add a discriminating synthetic fixture in `src/review/core.test.ts` that drives the real `auditWriteEvidenceOutsideScope` (and, where useful, `runReview`) with a `docs/plans/active/<X>/decisions.md` WriteEvidence content path outside the plan's `ObservedWriteScope`, beside an undeclared `src/secret.ts` control. On the current tree the docs path is silently exempted while the ordinary path raises; capture that genuine red with command output. Record truthful attempt provenance during EXECUTE as the fail→pass pair; do not manufacture a retrospective red or run the old publisher archive as the acceptance population.

In `src/review/core.ts`, remove the `isDocsPlansPath` predicate definition and its single bypass call in `auditWriteEvidenceOutsideScope`, so a `docs/plans/` path is judged by the ordinary coverage path (exact declared `File`, relevant declared `Glob`, and same-ID `.ngrace/` archive-identity expansion). Update the associated comments that name the removed F27.1 authority-roadmap hole. Do not modify `auditScopeOutsideWriteScope`, `isCliLifecyclePath`, `isCanonicalEngineCandidateLockPath`, `expandScopePathsForArchiveIdentity`, `observedWriteScopeContains`, the `WriteEvidenceScopeAuditReport` fields, or the ledger/loose event loading; do not add a suppression list, override flag, configuration key, or exported predicate that reinstates the privilege.

In `src/review/catalog.ts`, correct the `review.write-evidence-outside-scope` explanation so it no longer claims authority ownership of `docs/plans/`. Keep the code bound to `WRITE_EVIDENCE_SCOPE_FINDING_CODE` at severity `error`; state that the preserved path-class exclusions are the CLI lifecycle class (`run.xml`, `run-ledger.xml`, `run/**` under a canonical `C-*` bundle) and the exact canonical engine candidate lock, and that undeclared non-lifecycle `.ngrace/` paths still raise.

Undeclared and declared behavior, proved by synthetic fixtures not the archive: (a) an undeclared `docs/plans/active/<X>/decisions.md` and `review.md` each produce exactly one finding whose code is `WRITE_EVIDENCE_SCOPE_FINDING_CODE`, whose severity is `error`, and whose `file` is that path; (b) an undeclared `src/secret.ts` raises identically; (c) the same path repeated across WriteEvidence appearances and present on only one of several ledger/loose attempt events still yields exactly one finding (deduplication plus union across attempts); (d) with the recorded WriteEvidence path fixed, an exact declared `File` and a relevant declared `Glob` each yield zero `review.write-evidence-outside-scope` findings, and coverage is not widened to swallow a sibling undeclared path; (e) missing or empty comparable WriteEvidence yields `writeEvidenceScopeAudit.status === "unable-to-determine"` with a non-empty reason, never a clean `ran`, while at least one comparable path yields `ran` (findingCount may be 0). The finding shape and the `writeEvidenceScopeAudit` fields (`status`, `reason`, `changeId`, `pathCount`, `findingCount`) are unchanged.

Preserved boundaries, proved by synthetic projects that replace (rather than flip or re-pin) the direct `C-ESCALATION-HONESTY`/`docs/plans` coupling and the whole-archive WriteEvidence multiset ratchet: (a) the separate working-tree `auditScopeOutsideWriteScope` still reports changed `docs/plans/` paths under `review.scope-outside-write-scope`; (b) `run.xml`, `run-ledger.xml`, and `run/**` under a canonical `C-*` bundle are filtered, and the exact canonical candidate lock `.ngrace/changes/active/.candidate-<C-ID>.lock` is filtered while every near miss (archived location, extra nesting, another top-level directory, malformed id) raises; (c) an undeclared approved `spec.xml`/`plan.xml` and any other undeclared non-lifecycle `.ngrace/` content raise; (d) the same-ID `.ngrace/changes/{active,archive}/<id>/...` identity expansion for the reviewed change's own artifacts remains, an undeclared path naming another change's bundle raises, and an exact declared foreign path passes. Existing byte-immutability, lifecycle, candidate-lock, and unrelated controls are kept, not deleted to obtain green.

Real source CLI on clean committed disposable projects, each probe driven mutate→observed→exact restoration with honest provenance: undeclared docs evidence refuses with exactly `review.write-evidence-outside-scope`; with the recorded evidence path fixed, an exact-`File` plan variant and a relevant-`Glob` plan variant pass; a sibling or ordinary undeclared path still refuses; empty evidence reports `unable-to-determine`. Also drive the CLI for undeclared non-lifecycle `.ngrace/` content, lifecycle/candidate-lock exceptions, and every specified near miss. The narrow `bun test --timeout=0 src/review/core.test.ts` command is the task's resulting-tree instrument; the applied-archive CI is a later, distinct state owned by the close-bound criteria.
